dz: 卡利夫·穆斯塔克菲被布依德帝国的统治者穆伊兹·多拉蒙蔽并废黜. 他由al-Muti接任为阿巴斯哈里发的哈里发.
de: Caliph al-Mustakfi is blinded and deposed by Mu'izz al-Dawla, ruler of the Buyid Empire. He is succeeded by al-Muti as caliph of the Abbasid Caliphate.

t: 斯波莱托的阿尔贝里克二世在教宗马里努斯二世去世后安排了阿加佩图斯二世的教皇选举.
te: Alberic II of Spoleto arranges the election of pope Agapetus II following the death of Pope Marinus II.
dz: 斯波莱托的阿尔贝里克二世在教宗马里努斯二世去世后安排了阿加佩图斯二世的教皇选举.
de: Alberic II of Spoleto arranges the election of pope Agapetus II following the death of Pope Marinus II.

t: 铃木天皇放弃了王位,支持成为日本第62任皇帝的弟弟村上.
te: Emperor Suzaku abdicates the throne in favor of his brother Murakami who becomes the 62nd emperor of Japan.
dz: 铃木天皇放弃了王位,支持成为日本第62任皇帝的弟弟村上.
de: Emperor Suzaku abdicates the throne in favor of his brother Murakami who becomes the 62nd emperor of Japan.

te: England is left temporarily without a monarch after the death of King Edmund I in a street fight, resulting in Edmund's…
dz: 国王埃德蒙一世在街头冲突中身亡后，英格兰一度没有君主。由于埃德蒙的两个儿子尚未成年，其弟埃德雷德继承王位。
de: England is left temporarily without a monarch after the death of King Edmund I in a street fight, resulting in Edmund's brother Eadred assuming the throne for the minority of Edmund's two sons.
